sampling.targetPopulation: A fixed, balanced capability-diagnostic set for Tango registered music-task operations; not a representative sample of all users.
sampling.selection: All cases committed to this artifact before execution. Live execution must save a case-ID manifest and suite SHA-256 before the first provider request. Case failures must not be removed or relabeled after seeing results.

splits.holdout: No prompt or implementation tuning on these cases before a reported frozen run. Once used for tuning, report them as reused and create a new untouched suite for future generalization claims.
splits.challenge: Explicit adversarial, metadata-unknown, fault and boundary stress cases; not intended to approximate natural traffic.
splits.manual: Not measured unless independent blinded listeners supply actual ratings.

limitations: Live-model controlled-catalog tests measure intent, orchestration and constraint handling, not real NetEase retrieval recall.
Synthetic song metadata and style tags do not prove audio language, BPM, scene fit or subjective recommendation quality.
No suite can cover every adversarial input; the artifact enumerates a finite threat model.
Unavailable evidence remains unverified in conservative accuracy and strict completion denominators.
Do not merge live-model, deterministic faults and human-audio scores into an unlabeled product-quality rate.
Latency from controlled tools is not production end-to-end latency.

goldPolicy.source: Human-authored expected outcomes and explicit synthetic metadata truth, independent of production validators and production check statuses.
goldPolicy.completeIntentMatch: All explicitly specified meaningful intent fields, required membership, date bounds and clarification concepts must match. Outcome status and preview success are scored separately. Empty/default fields appear only when their absence/revocation has semantic significance.
goldPolicy.taskCompletion: All expected per-turn output and boundary criteria must pass. Unknown evidence is not completed.
goldPolicy.accuracy: Conservative gold-criterion accuracy includes unverified criteria in its denominator; observed-only accuracy and evidence coverage are reported separately.
goldPolicy.audioQuality: Not measured by this automated suite.
